items.title: Geordie Greep Cancels US Tour Following Sexual Misconduct Allegation
items.summary: On Thursday (Oct. 8), Geordie Greep was accused of sexual assault via flyers handed out to fans waiting on line for his Vancouver show.

items.title: Ella Langley Cancels Tulsa Concert Following Bomb Threat: Report
items.summary: A preliminary sweep of the venue by officers and K-9 units found no indication of a threat, but the show was nonetheless cancelled. Ella Langley Cancels Tulsa Concert Following Bomb Threat: Report Alex Young

items.title: ‘Ray Gunn’ Review: Sam Rockwell And Scarlett Johansson Channel Bogie And Bacall In Brad Bird’s Nifty Sci-Fi/Film Noir Mashup – London Film Festival
items.summary: If David Ellison wants a ticket to the Oscars this year it most likely won’t be with anything from Paramount or even (so far) from Warner Bros, but if you said Netflix you might be on the right track.

items.title: Nicolas Cage Says He’s ‘Probably Not’ Working With Amazon Again After Refusing to Sign AI Waiver for ‘Spider-Noir,’ Teases Joining ‘True Detective’
items.summary: Nicolas Cage is speaking out against Amazon after the company, which developed “Spider-Noir” for Prime Video, allegedly asked him to sign an AI waiver.

items.title: Charli XCX Brings Out Tinashe At ACL
items.summary: Charli XCX's Music, Fashion, Film and Tinashe's Popstar are easily two of the best albums of the year. Last weekend, Charli brought out Troye Sivan for her Austin City Limits headlining set.
